name: Birch Research claim corpus
about: Dated, frozen releases of the claim corpus. Each release is immutable: cite one by its date and your citation stays checkable. The live, always-current index is at https://birch.insure/claims.json, which is deliberately not versioned and should not be cited as a dataset. Release 2026-09-09 is the original frozen bytes; locators in this index use the Birch canonical host.
